items.notes: Central Bank of Iran, Selected Economic Indicators (گزیده آمارهای اقتصادی), monetary part. An END-OF-MONTH STOCK, not a monthly average: each value is the balance at the end of the Jalali month in ref_period_label, and ref_period_start/end are that month's Gregorian span. Stored EXACTLY as printed, in thousand billion rials (هزار میلیارد ریال = 1e12 rial); divide by 10 for همت (1e12 toman) — the conversion is for display only. Sources: the monthly Excel editions (Tir 1399 onwards; each prints the same month last year, last Esfand and the current month, so months from Tir 1398 plus Esfand 1397 are covered) and, for the quarter-ends no Excel edition carries (1352 to Khordad 1398, Esfand 1397 excepted), the CBI time-series viewer's values (four decimals rather than one; published_at NULL, available_at the day they were ingested). CBI states no publication date: published_at is the workbook's own last-saved timestamp, a lower bound. Editions arrive three weeks to five and a half months after the month ends (21 to 164 days measured), often in batches. A value restated in a later edition is a new vintage beside the print it revises. NOT seasonally adjusted. BREAK: CBI redefined base money — its foreign assets revalued in 1402 and the components reclassified to the IMF's MFSMCG 2016 — for months from Esfand 1399 / 1400 on, and restated those months in later editions (Esfand 1400: 6,039.7 -> 5,981.1; Esfand 1401: 8,599.9 -> 8,548.0). Every row carries method 'old' or 'revised' and growth is never computed across the two; levels on different methods are not comparable, hence chain_growth. Read as the SOURCES side (پایه پولی از سمت منابع), checked against the uses side on every ingest. The newest editions label it «کاملا مقدماتی» (fully preliminary).
